theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → T.massOn W < ∞) → ∃ (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), μ Uᶜ = 0 ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) ∧ (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = μ W) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ ∧ (∀ (x : Euclid P) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μ) ∧ ((∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → boundaryMassOn T W < ∞) → ∀ E : Set (Euclid P), μHE[n] E = 0 → μ E = 0)) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) → (∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (k + 1)) (μ μ' : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (k + 1)) (ξ' : Euclid P → MultiVector P k) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ' K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ' μ' → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (k + 1), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ', ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) k, |ξ' x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (k + 1), T ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (k + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ η : TestFormOn U k, T.boundary η = ∫ x, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ') → LipschitzWith L f → ∃ (A : ℝ → GeometricCurrentOn U (k + 1)) (B : ℝ → GeometricCurrentOn U k), (∀ (t : ℝ) (ω : TestFormOn U (k + 1)), A t ω = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (k + 1)) x) ∂μ) ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (η : TestFormOn U k), B t η = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μ') ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (η : TestFormOn U k), Disjoint (tsupport (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) {x | f x = t} → (A t).boundary η = B t η) ∧ (∀ (W : Set (Euclid P)) (t : ℝ), IsOpen W → ((A t).boundary - B t).massOn W ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * μ (W ∩ {x | t - h < f x ∧ f x < t})) (𝓝[>] 0)) ∧ (∀ (W : Set (Euclid P)) (a b : ℝ), IsOpen W → ∫⁻ t in Ioo a b, ((A t).boundary - B t).massOn W ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * μ (W ∩ {x | a < f x ∧ f x < b}))) → (∀ (P m : ℕ), ∃ c : NNReal, 1 ≤ c ∧ ∀ (ρ : ℝ) (K : Set (Euclid P)) (Λ : NNReal), 0 < ρ → IsCompact K → ∃ 𝒬 : Set (GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), 𝒬.Finite ∧ ∀ T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity T → T.support ⊆ K → T.mass ≤ Λ → T.boundary.mass < ∞ → ∃ Q ∈ 𝒬, ∃ (R : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity Q ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity Q.boundary ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity R ∧ T - Q - S = R.boundary ∧ (Q = 0 ∨ ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ (m + 1)) ≤ Q.mass) ∧ Q.mass ≤ c * T.mass ∧ Q.boundary.mass ≤ c * T.boundary.mass ∧ R.mass ≤ c * ENNReal.ofReal ρ * T.mass ∧ S.mass ≤ c * ENNReal.ofReal ρ * T.boundary.mass ∧ Q.support ∪ R.support ⊆ thickening (3 * Real.sqrt P * ρ) T.support ∧ Q.boundary.support ∪ S.support ⊆ thickening (3 * Real.sqrt P * ρ) T.boundary.support) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → ∀ (P d : ℕ), ∃ η₀ : ℝ, 0 < η₀ ∧ ∀ (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (d + 1)), C.boundary = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → C.massOn W = μ W) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), C ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ (μ μ' : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (d + 1)) (ξ' : Euclid P → MultiVector P d), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ' K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ' μ' → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) (d + 1), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ', ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) d, |ξ' x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), C ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, (C).boundary η = ∫ x, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂μ') → ∀ (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), LipschitzWith L f → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ∀ (A : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1)) (B : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d), (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), A ω = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (d + 1)) x) ∂μ) → (∀ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, B η = ∫ x in {x | f x < t}, ξ' x ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) x) ∂μ') → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A.boundary - B)) → ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ENNReal.ofReal η₀ ≤ liminf (fun r : ℝ => μ (ball x r) / (unitBallVolume (d + 1) * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (d + 1)))) (𝓝[>] 0)
